name: Caltagirone SpA
summary: Caltagirone SpA, through its subsidiaries, engages in the construction business in Italy, Denmark, Belgium, the United States, Turkey, Egypt, China, Malaysia, Australia, and internationally. The company offers cement, aggregates, concrete, and value-added products; and traditional and free daily press, internet, social press, and publishing services. It is also involved in the leasing, sale, enhancement, maintenance, and management of residential units and apartments; civil engineering and construction of railway lines; and insurance and related finance services.
